name: engram
displayName: engram — Recursive Language Model for Claude Code
shortDescription: Infinite-feeling context for Claude Code. The codebase is never loaded — Claude examines it via a logged REPL of coding-native primitives.
longDescription: engram brings the December 2025 Recursive Language Model paradigm (Zhang, Kraska, Khattab — MIT CSAIL) to Claude Code, specialized for code. Instead of stuffing your repository into the context window (where lost-in-the-middle costs you 25–60% retrieval at long ranges), engram exposes five coding-native primitives — grep, read, ast, git, recurse — that Claude programmatically calls. Every call is journaled to an append-only audit log: provable, replayable, local-first.
